penn-gcb.name: Cesar de la Fuente
penn-gcb.why: 近两年以末位作者提出用于肽/蛋白质定制设计的优化框架（key-cutting machine）和生成式 AI 肽优化方法，直接对应方向 B5 的 de novo 生成设计。
papers: Key-cutting machine: A novel optimization framework
Tailored structured peptide design
A generative artificial intelligence approach for peptide

penn-gcb.name: Eugene Katsevich
penn-gcb.why: 专门为单细胞 CRISPR 筛选开发统计推断方法（低 MOI 下的稳健差异表达检验、指数族测量误差模型），正对方向 A1。
papers: Robust differential expression testing for single-cell CRISPR
Exponential family measurement error models for single-cell CRISPR
Saddlepoint approximations for plug-in resampling

penn-gcb.name: Jin Jin
penn-gcb.why: 开发基于 GWAS summary statistics 的多祖源贝叶斯 PRS（MUSSEL）和潜变量暴露的孟德尔随机化方法，同时覆盖方向 A3 的 PGS 与 MR。
papers: MUSSEL: Enhanced Bayesian polygenic risk prediction
Bayesian Mendelian Randomization Analysis for Latent Exposures
Mendelian randomization analysis using multiple biomarkers

penn-gcb.name: Bogdan Pasaniuc
penn-gcb.why: 将多基因风险与单细胞甲基化数据整合（met-scDRS），并参与跨生物库的局部祖源感知关联分析框架，属方向 A3 统计遗传学方法。
papers: Integration of polygenic risk with single cell methylation data
Integration of polygenic risk with single cell methylation profiles
A unified framework for local-ancestry-aware

penn-gcb.name: Gregory R. Bowman
penn-gcb.why: 用计算模拟研究蛋白质构象动力学与相互作用界面（抗体成熟如何改变接触区刚性、同源寡聚体对称性预测），与方向 B6 结构预测及 B4 抗体亲和力相关。
papers: Antibody maturation increases rigidity
Rapid and accurate prediction of protein homo-oligomer symmetry
G Protein Activation Occurs via a Largely Universal Mechanism

penn-gcb.name: Marylyn D Ritchie
penn-gcb.why: 开发基于 GWAS summary statistics 的贝叶斯位点识别方法（SABER），并研究 PGS 在不同人群队列中的表现差异，属方向 A3。
papers: SABER: Statistical Identification of Loci of Interest
Risk factors affecting polygenic score performance
CASTER-DTA: equivariant graph neural networks

penn-gcb.name: Dokyoon Kim
penn-gcb.why: 研究 PRS 中样本重叠造成的过拟合偏差，并比较蛋白组评分与 PRS 的互补预测能力，属方向 A3 多基因评分方法。
papers: Addressing overfitting bias due to sample overlap
Plasma protein-based and polygenic risk scores
Pathway Modeling of Genomic and Tissue-Specific

penn-gcb.name: Sara Mathieson
penn-gcb.why: 用自监督 transformer 和 CNN 做群体遗传推断（自然选择信号检测），属计算基因组学方法，但偏群体遗传而非 GWAS/MR。
papers: Popformer: Learning general signatures of positive selection
Interpreting convolutional neural networks in population genetics
Fast pairwise coalescence enables
